analysis_context.relationship_to_locked_audit: Secondary sensitivity analysis created after the original locked test audit
analysis_context.selection_basis: The 0.40 positive-risk upper-bound limit was selected from validation risk curves only; the original test result remains the primary result
analysis_context.interpretation: Hypothesis-generating comparison, not independent confirmation or a clinical safety claim

intended_use.population: Adults represented by PTB-XL receiving a 10-second resting ECG
intended_use.role: Retrospective sensitivity analysis of automated positive AFIB triage
intended_use.claim_boundary: Not a clinical diagnosis, prospective validation, deployment authorization, or replacement for clinician confirmation

primary_analysis.interpretation: Exploratory upper-bound constraint chosen to make a validation-fitted 2-lead/12-lead positive route estimable; not a clinically acceptable error target

secondary_analysis.multiplicity: Descriptive; no confirmatory claims from this post-hoc sensitivity analysis

locking_rules: Fit calibration and thresholds on validation predictions only
Keep the original afib_v1 locked-test result unchanged and primary
Apply the exploratory policy to test predictions without refitting
Do not select another threshold or risk limit from exploratory test results
Require new untouched external data for any confirmatory claim
